content: In INLINEFORM0 , if LiLi wins the episode, it adds INLINEFORM1 in one of data buffers INLINEFORM2 based on its mode INLINEFORM3 . E.g., if INLINEFORM4 or INLINEFORM5 , INLINEFORM6 is used for training and added to INLINEFORM7 . Similarly validation buffer INLINEFORM8 and evaluation buffer INLINEFORM9 are populated. If INLINEFORM10 , LiLi invokes the prediction model for INLINEFORM11 .
